definitions.explanation: Food cooked by deep-frying in oil. A fundamental Japanese cooking method producing crispy dishes.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷらは{日本|にほん}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}です。
examples.english: Tempura is a representative Japanese fried dish.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}は{油|あぶら}の{温度|おんど}が{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: Oil temperature is important for fried foods.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}は{揚|あ}げたてが{一番|いちばん}{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Fried food is best when freshly fried.

notes:
{揚|あ}げ{物|もの} refers to deep-fried foods ({揚|あ}げる = to deep-fry).

Common Japanese fried dishes:
- {天|てん}ぷら (tempura) - light batter
- {唐揚|からあ}げ (karaage) - fried chicken
- とんかつ (tonkatsu) - breaded pork cutlet
- コロッケ (croquette)
- {海老|えび}フライ (fried shrimp)

Frying techniques:
- {素揚|すあ}げ (no coating)
- {衣揚|ころもあ}げ (with batter/coating)
- パン{粉|こ}をつけて{揚|あ}げる (breaded)

Related cooking methods:
- {煮物|にもの} (simmered)
- {焼|や}き{物|もの} (grilled)
- {蒸|む}し{物|もの} (steamed)
